cc:Work.dc:title: Safety Gate v0.3: fixed scripted actions with gate OFF / ON
cc:Work.dc:description: 160 scenarios and 320 pipeline runs per freeze version. Gate ON allowed all 80 valid actions and blocked all 80 invalid actions. ScriptedPlanner, max_steps=1, LLM generation=0; these counts do not estimate LLM safety or task success. Freeze 1.0.5 changed the blocking reason in 40 approval-email rows, while aggregate outcomes stayed identical. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported. Sources: docs/experiments/reports/task-criticality-safety-gate-2026-11-15.md

ScriptedPlanner, max_steps=1, LLM generation=0; these counts do not estimate LLM safety or task success. Freeze 1.0.5 changed the blocking reason in 40 approval-email rows, while
aggregate outcomes stayed identical. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported.
